GET USER ACCOUNT 
curl -v -H "Accept: application/json" -H "Authorization: Bearer " \
-H "Content-Type: application/json" \
"https://inb.bsc.es/auth/realms/datatools4heart/account/"

GET USER INFO 
curl -H "Accept: application/json" -H "Authorization: Bearer " "https://inb.bsc.es/auth/realms/datatools4heart/protocol/openid-connect/userinfo"


PUT DATA 

curl -H "Accept: application/json" -H \
"Authorization: Bearer " -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
"https://inb.bsc.es/auth/realms/datatools4heart/account/" -d \
'{
   "attributes": {
     "given_name": "Chara",
     "family_name": "Tsoukala",
     "institution": "Athena Research Center",
     "bcsecret": ""
   }
}'


here you can get certs and public keys to verify token (token has a signature )
